LESSON: ENVIRONMENTAL AWARENESS

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP1
Subject: General
Strand: Listening and Speaking
Topic 1.1: Environmental awareness
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Environmental awareness, part of Listening and Speaking in SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP1 General.

Key inquiry question: How do we use different things in our environment?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Environmental awareness together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Communication and collaboration: listening and speaking as the learner interacts with others in talking about things found in the

neighbourhood.

Values:
● Responsibility is enhanced as the learner learns how to care for some of the things found in the environment like pets, plants.

● Respect is enhanced as the learner patiently takes turn with others in talking about things found in the neighbourhood.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Environmental awareness is enhanced as the learner learns about things found in the neighbourhood and their uses.

Link to other Learning Areas: Environmental activities as learners take care of the environment

Suggested learning resources: Pets, roads, cars, animals, play fields, people, and houses, video clip ,pictures of things found in

the neighbourhood
